source: Claude Sonnet 5.5, one call per meditation with the whole transcript (temp_scripts/ai-frames-pilot/llm/claude-frames.ts, run 83-proposal). Suggestions the editors already made are left out.

suggestions.text: We can place both our hands on the earth or let our hands hang down to our side if you are sitting on a chair.
suggestions.reason: Both hands placed on the earth.

suggestions.text: Keeping our right hand towards or on the earth, we can place our left hand back on our lap, palm facing upwards, hand open.
suggestions.reason: Right hand stays on earth, left hand back on lap.

suggestions.text: We can place our right hand back on our lap, palm facing upwards, and bending our left hand at the elbow, palm fingertips facing, and bending our left hand at the elbow, fingertips, Towards the sky, palm facing backwards, as you can see on the image on the screen, we use the air, the ether element to cool down our right channel, which is the channel of all action, all forms of mental, physical action that we express, all future planning, anything to do with our future, when we use a lot of physical or mental energy.
suggestions.reason: Right hand to lap, left hand raised bent at elbow, palm backwards; final position.

suggestions.text: If you feel your hand is getting tired, you can place it back on the lap.
suggestions.reason: Hand placed back on lap if tired; next instruction is not immediate.

suggestions.text: So starting from the bottom of our spine with our right hand, We can slowly raise our kundalini energy all the way up to the top of our head, to our fontanel bone area.
suggestions.reason: Raising Kundalini with right hand to the top of the head.

suggestions.text: And after the third time we can place our right hand palm facing Downwards onto our fontanel bone.
suggestions.reason: Right hand placed palm down on fontanel.

suggestions.text: We can press down and rotate our scalp in a clockwise direction towards our right shoulder.
suggestions.reason: Rotating the scalp clockwise is the massage.

suggestions.text: We can raise our hand a few inches or centimeters above our head.
suggestions.reason: Hand held a few inches above the head to feel vibrations.

suggestions.text: Just observe. Bringing our hand back to our lap, palm facing upwards.
suggestions.reason: Hand back on lap, attention stays on the top of the head.
